notes: Text uses [E] for one Energy icon. cost: 'X' = X-cost, 'U' = unplayable; cost_upgraded only when the upgrade changes it. text_upgraded is null for cards that cannot be upgraded (extra.no_upgrade). keywords come from the infobox GivesToPlayer/GivesToEnemy/PowerGives/InteractsWith fields plus keyword/buff templates in the description; a power named after the card itself is in extra.self_power instead. extra.keyword_roles keeps who receives each (player/enemy/...). Choice cards are folded into their parent as extra.variants (StS1 Wish options; StS2 Mad Science's 9 Tinker Time variants). Curses/Statuses use owner 'Curse'/'Status'; Special-rarity entries are generated cards (Shiv, Miracle, Beta...). keyword_glossary.Bias: At the start of your turn, lose X Focus.
keyword_glossary.Blasphemer: At the start of your turn, die.
keyword_glossary.Block Return: When attacked, you gain X Block.
keyword_glossary.Calm: Upon exiting this Stance, gain 2 [E] Energy.
keyword_glossary.Channel: Channeling an Orb puts it into your first empty slot. If you have no empty slots, your first Orb is automatically Evoked to make room.
keyword_glossary.Dark: Passive: Increase stored damage by 6 (+1 per Focus). Evoke: Deal stored damage damage to the enemy with the least HP.
keyword_glossary.Dexterity: Increase Block gained from cards by X.
keyword_glossary.Dexterity (Negative): Lose X Dexterity: Block gained from cards is X lower.
keyword_glossary.Discard: Put a card from your hand into the discard pile without playing it.
keyword_glossary.Divinity: Upon entering this Stance, gain 3 [E] Energy. Attacks deal triple damage. Exit this Stance at the start of your next turn.
keyword_glossary.Draw: Move cards from the top of your draw pile into your hand (the discard pile is reshuffled into it when it runs out).
keyword_glossary.Energized: Gain X additional [E] Energy next turn.
keyword_glossary.Energy: Energy is used to play cards from your Hand.
keyword_glossary.Ethereal: If an Ethereal card is in your hand at the end of your turn, it is Exhausted.
keyword_glossary.Evoke: Consume your rightmost Orb and use its Evoke effect.
keyword_glossary.Exhaust: Removed until the end of combat.
keyword_glossary.Fatal: Fatal effects occur when a card kills a non-minion enemy.
keyword_glossary.Focus: Increases the effectiveness of Orbs by X.
keyword_glossary.Frail: Gain 25% less Block from cards for X turns.
keyword_glossary.Frost: Passive: Gain 2 (+1 per Focus) Block. Evoke: Gain 5 (+1 per Focus) Block.
keyword_glossary.Gold: Run currency, spent at the Merchant.
keyword_glossary.Heal: Restore HP, up to your Max HP.
keyword_glossary.Heatsink: Whenever you play a Power card, draw X cards.
keyword_glossary.Hello: At the start of your turn, add X random Common cards into your hand.
keyword_glossary.Innate: Start each combat with this card in your hand.
keyword_glossary.Intangible: Reduce ALL damage taken and HP loss to 1.
keyword_glossary.Lightning: Passive: Deal 3 (+1 per Focus) damage to a random enemy. Evoke: Deal 8 (+1 per Focus) damage to a random enemy.
keyword_glossary.Lock-On: Receives 50% more damage from Orbs for X turns.
keyword_glossary.Lose HP: Lose HP directly; Block does not prevent it (self-damage costs, or damage that skips Block).
keyword_glossary.Mantra: Whenever you gain 10 Mantra, enter Divinity.
keyword_glossary.Mark: Whenever you play Pressure Points, lose X HP.
keyword_glossary.No Block: You cannot gain Block from cards.
keyword_glossary.No Draw: You cannot draw cards this turn.
keyword_glossary.Orb: Defect resource: Channel puts an Orb into an Orb slot; each Orb has a passive effect every turn and a stronger one-shot Evoke effect when pushed out or evoked. Focus boosts both.
keyword_glossary.Orb Slot: Orbs can be channeled into these slots. The Defect starts with 3 slots, which can be increased with cards, relics, or potions.
keyword_glossary.Plasma: Passive: Gain 1 [E] Energy. Evoke: Gain 2 [E] Energy.
keyword_glossary.Plated Armor: At the end of your turn, receive X Block. Receiving unblocked damage reduces Plated Armor by 1.
keyword_glossary.Poison: At the start of its turn, loses X HP, then reduce Poison by 1.
keyword_glossary.Retain: Retained cards are not discarded at the end of turn.
keyword_glossary.Scry: Look at the top X cards of your draw pile. You may discard any of them.
keyword_glossary.Shackled: At the end of its turn, gains X Strength.
keyword_glossary.Shiv: Generated Attack card (cost 0): Deal 4 damage. Exhaust.
keyword_glossary.Simmering Rage: Enter Wrath at the start of your turn.
keyword_glossary.Stance: Watcher mode: Calm, Wrath or Divinity (or none). Only one at a time; cards enter/exit stances and many cards trigger on a stance change.
keyword_glossary.Strength (Negative): Lose X Strength (enemy or self): attacks deal X less damage.
keyword_glossary.Strength Down: At the end of this turn, lose X Strength.
keyword_glossary.Transform: Transformed cards become a random card of any rarity.
keyword_glossary.Unplayable: Cannot be played from your Hand.
keyword_glossary.Upgrade: Upgrading cards makes them more powerful. Most cards can only be upgraded once.
keyword_glossary.Vigor: Your next attack deals X additional damage per hit.
keyword_glossary.Vulnerable: Receive 50% more damage from Attacks for X turns.
keyword_glossary.Weak: Attacks deal 25% less damage for X turns.
keyword_glossary.Wrath: In this Stance, you deal and receive double attack damage.
